material_gate: full opaque coverage, not transparent-sprite perimeter gate
seam_status: not claimed seamless; periodic difference measured without offset, blur, edge lock or paint

visual_review.identity: Warm ochre-brown parched clay with large irregular rounded soil plates and a sparse thin dark-brown crack network. No stone paving, vegetation, gravel, glow or water.
visual_review.palette_caveat: Brighter and more golden/orange than the original muted ochre-brown swatch; still distinct from the red scorched soil.
visual_review.density_caveat: Only about 3-5 dominant clay plates across width rather than proposed 8-12. Clean broad plate interiors with a few low-contrast value planes; this is the lowest microdetail member of the quartet.
visual_review.scale_caveat: Large clay plates can span about 50-100 world units at the 256 preview period. These natural crack marks require scale review and are not gameplay boundaries.
visual_review.native_acceptance: 1254 fully opaque native candidate, catalog-only tone 3. No scene binding or natural seamlessness claim.

reference_material_identity: Warm ochre-brown dried compact clay/earth broken into irregular rounded polygon plates by narrow dark cracks, with almost no vegetation. Continuous parched ground, not fitted masonry, lava, water or a rubble pile.
period_status: candidate parent integration parameter, not bound by this source handoff
